title: Penalty for other offences
chapter: Chapter VIII — Offences, Penalties, and Trial
text: Penalty for other offences.— If a person acts in breach of any provision of this Act for which no specific penalty is provided for in th is Act, than that person shall be punished with an imprisonment for a term which may be up to six months, or with a penalty, which may be up to Bangladeshi Taka Fifty Thousand or both together.
source: Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013 (official English translation)
